page: Microsoft Azure B2ts_v2 is a burstable, entry-level virtual machine instance within the Bsv2 series. It operates on an Intel Xeon Platinum 8370C processor running at 2.8 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. Virtualized via Microsoft Hyper-V, the instance provides 2 burstable vCPUs mapped to 1 physical core across 2 threads. The CPU supports instruction sets including AVX, AVX-512F, AVX-512 VNNI, AES-NI, and SHA extensions. Memory capacity is constrained to 1.0 GB of RAM, equating to 0.5 GB per vCPU, and the instance includes no local storage or bundled GPUs.

Benchmark evaluations highlight the severe resource limitations imposed by the 1.0 GB memory footprint and burstable CPU scheduling. While stress-ng single-core performance registers an average score of 1890.49, multi-core throughput drops to 1932.88, landing in the bottom 10 percent of evaluated instances. PassMark overall CPU score reaches 3012.61, with weak performance in encryption (1809.75) and physics testing (370.97). Read memory bandwidth for large 256 MB blocks measures 13.88 GB/sec, while large uncached write operations drop to 0.97 GB/sec. Redis SET throughput achieves 2.02 million operations per second, and static web serving throughput measures 3.7 GB/sec.

The primary tradeoff of the B2ts_v2 is its minimal memory configuration relative to its dual vCPU allocation, paired with reliance on remote storage. Cost efficiency is qualitative: it minimizes infrastructure overhead for idle or lightweight components, but its low memory bandwidth and constrained RAM limit processing capacity. Consequently, the instance is appropriate for low-traffic static web servers, lightweight microservices, basic testing environments, network proxies, or background monitoring daemons with minimal RAM requirements.
description: Microsoft Azure B2ts_v2 is an entry-tier burstable virtual machine powered by a 2.8 GHz Intel Xeon Platinum 8370C processor on the x86_64 architecture. Managed by Microsoft Hyper-V, it provides 2 burstable vCPUs derived from 1 physical core with simultaneous multithreading, alongside 1.0 GB of system memory (0.5 GB per vCPU). The instance includes no bundled GPUs and relies entirely on external storage. In benchmark testing, the B2ts_v2 demonstrates mid-tier single-thread compute via stress-ng (1890.49) but ranks in the lower tiers for multi-core performance (1932.88) and PassMark CPU metrics (3012.61). Memory bandwidth reaches 13.88 GB/sec read and 0.97 GB/sec write on large blocks, with static web serving throughput of 3.7 GB/sec. Due to strict memory constraints and burstable CPU allocation, this instance fits lightweight utility tasks, small internal tools, low-volume web serving, and basic testing environments.
